records.text: The word of the Lord that came to Hosea son of Beeri in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam son of Joash, king of Israel.

The beginning of the Lord’s word to Hosea. The Lord said to Hosea, “Go, take for yourself a woman of prostitution and children of prostitution, for the land will utterly prostitute itself away from following the Lord.”
What shall I do with you, Ephraim? What shall I do with you, Judah? Your mercy is like a morning cloud and like morning dew passing away.
Therefore I mowed down your prophets; I killed them with the words of My mouth, and My judgment will go forth like light.
For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice, and knowledge of God rather than whole burnt offerings.
But they are like a person transgressing a covenant; there he despised Me.
Gilead is a city working worthless things, stirring up water,
and your strength is that of a pirate. Priests concealed the Lord’s road; they murdered Shechem, because they committed lawlessness.
In Israel’s house I saw dreadful things, there Ephraim’s prostitution; Israel and Judah were defiled.
Begin harvesting for yourself when I turn back My people’s captivity,
